verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming app. A product of this kind could publish a developer API reference, so the axis applies. The evidence contains no interactive API reference or runnable examples, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The SillHost command-line run and the build-from-source instructions are developer tooling, not an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
